headline.purpose: Page heading ("O que você quer baixar?", "Downloads", "Ajustes").

title-section.purpose: "Seus downloads", dialog titles; settings group labels at 16px.

body.purpose: Default text; link field text at 15.5px.

meta.purpose: Row meta lines with middle-dot separators, field hints.

label.purpose: Field labels above selects, in dim ink.

numeral-live.purpose: Running percentage or file count on a row, in yellow; 26px below 1060px.

numeral-plate.purpose: Queue numbers on plates; 17px with 0.02em tracking for format codes (MP4, MP3, IMG).

numeral-state.purpose: "Entregue", "Na fila", "Pausado", "Falhou"; muted, gold or red by state.

shadows.name: action-bar-edge
shadows.purpose: Upward edge of the sticky action bar so content scrolls visibly beneath it.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, over a rgb(4 8 20 / 0.74) scrim.

motion.name: suave
motion.purpose: House ease-out for stripe width, switch, toast entry and the gold arrival.

motion.name: stripe-advance
motion.purpose: Running yellow stripe follows the percentage.

motion.name: stripe-indeterminate
motion.purpose: 26% yellow segment sweeping while reading a link or downloading a gallery of unknown size.

motion.name: stripe-arrival
motion.purpose: Gold wipes in left to right once, only for a download delivered during the current session.

motion.name: switch
motion.purpose: Switch track colour and knob travel.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition collapses; the indeterminate stripe becomes static yellow diagonal hatching (repeating-linear-gradient(-60deg, yellow 0 9px, transparent 9px 18px)) across the full width.

breakpoints.name: narrow-window
breakpoints.purpose: max-width: rows tighten, thumbnail 72x41, live numeral 26px, page side padding 24px, preview thumbnail column 176px, wide-only action-bar items hidden.

breakpoints.name: minimum-window
breakpoints.purpose: Electron minimum window width; nothing below it.

narrative.overview:
The Subaru WRC livery painted onto a Windows app. A navy chassis (title bar and rail), deeper navy panels for the work, one yellow that means "live" or "act now", and a gold that means "it arrived". Every download is a rally car on a stage: it carries a number plate, advances as a raked yellow stripe along the bottom edge of its row, and turns gold on delivery. The rally lives in the plates, the numerals and the stripe; the copy stays in plain Brazilian Portuguese for a layperson.

The density is that of a working tool, not a landing page. The first screen is the job itself: a heading with the Vídeo / Áudio / Imagens choice, a wide link field with the yellow plate, and the rows of downloads beneath, all on one screen. Paint is flat: navy panels separated by 1px navy rules, with depth reserved for things that actually float. Dark only, by the author's decision.

Two typefaces split the work cleanly. Segoe UI Variable carries every word; Barlow Condensed ExtraBold Italic appears only where a number or a plate needs the door-number voice, which is how live percentages read at a glance from across the window.
keyCharacteristics: Navy chassis, navy panels, navy-tinted text; no neutral greys anywhere.
Yellow is the one live and action colour; gold is delivered; red is failure.
Progress is a raked yellow livery stripe that turns gold on arrival.
Number plates mark queue position, and delivered rows carry their format (MP4, MP3, IMG) on a gold plate.
One solid yellow plate per screen, kept on screen by a sticky action bar.
Every selection shows its running total.

rules.name: The One Live Colour Rule
rules.body: Yellow means "act" or "running now" and nothing else. Done is never yellow; it is gold. Waiting is never yellow; it is dim navy.

rules.name: The Navy Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is always navy-tinted (tinta, muted, dim). No neutral grey text or surface exists in the system; every derived tone sits on the navy hue.

rules.name: The Gold Means Arrived Rule
rules.body: Gold is spent only on things that have reached the user: delivered rows, already-downloaded entries, the healthy-tools dot, and the "you already have this" notice.

rules.name: The Door Number Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed Italic is for numerals, plates and the one-word row state only. Never for headings, buttons or sentences.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every changing number (percent, speed, sizes, counts, times) uses tabular figures so rows do not jitter while they run.

rules.name: The Same Screen Rule
rules.body: Paste, choose, start and watch happen on one screen; the running and delivered rows sit directly under the field.

rules.name: The Flat Paint Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces carry no shadow, no gradient and no glow. A shadow is allowed only on a layer that floats (menu, toast, dialog) or on the sticky bar's scroll edge.

dos: Do keep exactly one solid yellow plate (the primary button) per screen or dialog, at the end of the reading order; when a preview opens, move it into the sticky action bar.
Do show progress as the livery stripe on the row's bottom edge: yellow and raked while running, gold and full when delivered.
Do keep every delivered row's stripe gold and static; animate the gold wipe only for an arrival during the session.
Do put the file format on the delivered row's gold plate (MP4, MP3, IMG).
Do set every changing number in tabular figures, and live numbers in Barlow Condensed ExtraBold Italic.
Do derive every new surface or text tone from the navy hue; nest wells darker than their panel.
Do separate regions with 1px rule-navy lines.
Do show a running total on every selection and strike already-downloaded entries in gold.
Do keep the Vídeo / Áudio / Imagens switch visible above the link field, beside the heading.
Do respect reduced motion: replace sweeping motion with static yellow hatching.
donts: Don't use yellow for finished or waiting states, or for the active chip or segment tile; done is gold, waiting is dim navy, the active tile is top-panel navy (only its icon turns yellow).
Don't use neutral grey for text or surfaces.
Don't set headings, buttons or sentences in Barlow Condensed.
Don't put gradients or glow on resting surfaces, or shadows on cards and rows; only floating layers and the sticky bar edge cast shadows.
Don't use a check mark on the delivered plate; it reads as a checkbox.
Don't nest a card inside a card; inline panels inside a card are plain ruled lists.
Don't leave the primary action where a long list can scroll it out of view.
